dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge with high falcation; spline fit indicates a sharp inward curvature initiating midway down the posterior margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a narrow pixel radius; distal-most tip exhibits a jagged structural indentation or notch.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior contour with an approximate 55-degree incline relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: 1.1:1 ratio of the visible base width to the vertical height of the fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive jagged notch or amputation at the distal apex of the dorsal fin; scattered small white punctate marks on the lateral flank.
